content.short: Curvegrid is a blockchain infrastructure-as-a-service platform for Web3 startup development.
content.description: Curvegrid provides MultiBaas, a blockchain middleware for Web3 startups. MultiBaas is a software development toolkit that enables developers to work with enhanced ABIs generated by the platform to build high-performance dApps. Developers can use the MultiBaas API to extend existing smart contracts and to write new ones, enabling added functionality to deployed contracts and the creation of fresh contracts.
